source_title: Ведомости Съезда народных депутатов СССР и Верховного Совета СССР, 1991, No. 36 (4 September 1991), scanned issue, Internet Archive capture 20250820135020; recorded for the CPSU

live_file_response.note: The live static file on the non-official SSSR.SU host, byte-identical to the recorded capture; requested without Accept-Encoding and served without Content-Encoding.

stability_check: This packet: downloaded at 2026-09-30T23:37:15Z and again at 2026-10-01T00:20:42Z (43 minutes later) with plain curl (curl's own User-Agent, 'Accept-Encoding: identity', no cookies, no cache-busting query, no redirect followed); identical 1,303,663 bytes and SHA-256; the attached responses also matched on both downloads. The base32 SHA-1 of the recorded bytes equals the Internet Archive CDX digest RG5TINDLZDABIRTQX3XQBQC477EQ5NQ3.
provenance_note: Raw Internet Archive capture (id_ form) of https://vedomosti.sssr.su/1991/36.pdf, captured at 2025-08-20T13:50:20Z, before the 7 September 2026 cutoff; requested with 'Accept-Encoding: identity' (curl without --compressed) and served without Content-Encoding, so the recorded identity is the uncompressed body as replayed (a request accepting gzip may be served gzip-encoded, with different bytes). The same bytes are served as a static file by the live host (live_file_response); the capture is recorded as the identity because it is fixed before the cutoff. The original response is not checked into this repository; this checked-in file is a derived factual extract, not the original response. Its own checksum is recorded separately in the packet.
rights_note: Attributed factual paraphrases only; no source artwork or portrait copied, and no photograph, emblem, signature image or expressive source text is republished. No open license is asserted. No portrait permission or likeness approval is established.
scope_note: The same bytes as su_ved_1991_36 (CLAUDE-C01-26), recorded under a new ID so that its extract stays unchanged. Only point 7 of the Supreme Soviet's resolution 2371-I of 29 August 1991 (Art. 1038) is imported, as an organization claim: the suspension of the CPSU's activity on the whole territory of the USSR.

edition_and_host.edition: Ведомости, 1991, № 36; Art. 1038 (resolution 2371-I) begins on printed p. 1445 (PDF p. 15); point 7 and the signature block on printed p. 1447 (PDF p. 17).
edition_and_host.host: SSSR.SU portal (snd.sssr.su, sten.vs.sssr.su, vedomosti.sssr.su): a non-commercial project registered as the media outlet 'Информационное агентство «СССР»' (Roskomnadzor ИА № ФС77-40345), not a state body and not the publisher; it serves page-image scans of the official publications as static files (see the CLAUDE-C01-SOURCE-26 review of the same host).

visual_review.method: Every cited page was rendered from the recorded bytes with PyMuPDF (100-150 dpi) and read from the page image, not from the OCR layer; headings, speaker lines, quotations and signature blocks were compared with the image.

rows.text: Resolution of the Supreme Soviet of the USSR 'О ситуации, возникшей в стране в связи с имевшим место государственным переворотом' (Art. 1038), 'Москва, Кремль 29 августа 1991 г. № 2371—I', point 7: 'На основании имеющихся сведений об участии руководящих органов КПСС в подготовке и проведении государственного переворота 18—21 августа 1991 года приостановить деятельность КПСС на всей территории СССР, поручив органам МВД обеспечить сохранность ее материальных ценностей и архивов, а учреждениям банков прекращение всех операций с денежными фондами КПСС.'
rows.locator: Art. 1038: heading, printed p. 1445 (PDF p. 15); point 7 and signature block, printed p. 1447 (PDF p. 17)

bounded_scope: CPSU General Secretary and Deputy General Secretary observations for CLAUDE-C01-41 only. Nomination and ballot, vote, election result, biographical election dates, vote figures, in-office attestations, resignation statements and references, acting service and the party's property, suspension and termination records stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. State offices, the RSFSR Communist Party, russia.json and the simulation's party rows are outside this extract.
